name: A failed replacement retires the predecessor it restored
A successor's hold does not count as an owner
replace: Owners(g, cl, lw) == cl[g] + Holds(g, lw)

name: Running keeps its lower source
replace:
lw == [lower EXCEPT ![g] = 0]
                      orphan == L # 0 /\ Owners(L, callers, lw) = 0
                      ph == [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "running"]

lw == lower
                      orphan == L # 0 /\ Owners(L, callers, lw) = 0
                      ph == [phase EXCEPT ![g] = "running"]

name: A canceled startup waits for its own success
The last owner leaves without stopping
replace: IF Owners(g, callers', lower) = 0 /\ phase[g] \in Live
